title: JSON schema for pair config file.

$schema.description: Link to the JSON schema for validation.

accessible.description: Replace TUI interactive prompts with standard prompts easier for screen readers to use.

coAuthors.description: Map of co-author display names to email addresses.

commitArgs.description: Additional arguments passed to git commit (for example: -s --no-verify).

prefixes.description: Allowed commit prefixes shown in the commit prompt.

suggestedCoAuthorEmail.description: Optional Go text/template used to suggest a co-author's email from their name in the 'add' command. Available fields: FirstName, LastName, FirstInitial, LastInitial. For example: {{.FirstInitial}}{{.LastName}}@example.com. The rendered result is lowercased.

ticketPrefix.description: Prefix added to ticket IDs when missing.
